{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: terratorch tuning toolkit

on: 
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths-ignore:
      - 'docs/**'
      - '*.md'
      - 'tests/resources/**'
      - 'examples/**/*'
      - '**/*.svg'
      - '**/*.png'
      - '**/*.txt'
      - '**/*.ipynb'
      - 'integrationtests/**/*'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths-ignore:
      - 'docs/**'
      - '*.md'
      - 'tests/resources/**'
      - 'examples/**/*'
      - '**/*.svg'
      - '**/*.png'
      - '**/*.txt'
      - '**/*.ipynb'
      - 'integrationtests/**/*'
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 3 * * *'
jobs:
  build:
    environment: cicd
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.13"]
    env:
      R_TESTS_VERBOSE: 2
      OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
      MKL_NUM_THREADS: "1"
      OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS: "1"
      NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS: "1"
    steps:
      - name: Clone repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install pip==25.1
          pip --version
          pip install -e .[test,tortilla,logging] -c constraints/test-py313.txt
      - name: List pip dependencies
        run: pip list
      - name: Test with pytest (fast)
        run: |
          pytest -s -v -m "not slow" tests

  slow-tests:
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    environment: cicd
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.13"]
    env:
      R_TESTS_VERBOSE: 2
      OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
      MKL_NUM_THREADS: "1"
      OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS: "1"
      NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS: "1"
    steps:
      - name: Clone repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install pip==25.1
          pip --version
          pip install -e .[test,tortilla,logging] -c constraints/test-py313.txt
      - name: Test with pytest (slow)
        run: |
          # pytest exit code 5 == "no tests collected". The only slow-marked tests
          # (test_detr.py) require the rfdetr extra and run in the rfdetr-tests job,
          # so nothing is selected here; treat 5 as success instead of failing the job.
          pytest -s -v -m "slow" tests || [ "$?" -eq 5 ]

  rfdetr-tests:
    environment: cicd
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.13"]
    env:
      R_TESTS_VERBOSE: 2
      OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
      MKL_NUM_THREADS: "1"
      OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS: "1"
      NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS: "1"
    steps:
      - name: Clone repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install pip==25.1
          pip --version
          pip install -e .[test,rfdetr] -c constraints/test-py313.txt
      - name: Test RF-DETR integration
        run: |
          pytest -s -v tests/test_detr.py -k "rfdetr"",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs three separate jobs (build, slow-tests, rfdetr-tests) that each install Python dependencies from pyproject.toml with a constraints file. Experimental evidence (experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2) shows that adding an explicit actions/cache@v4 step for ~/.cache/pip keyed on pyproject.toml hash yields ~9% elapsed time savings in a similar Python workflow that already used setup-python with pip caching. The pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE also supports caching dependency downloads. Adding the cache step to all three jobs preserves test coverage and introduces no new permissions or network access.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
